skill.bestialis.shadow_attack.name: Fear of the Dark
skill.bestialis.terminal_frenzy.desc: Below 30% health, deal 25% more damage and take 20% less damage.
skill.bestialis.terminal_frenzy.flavor: Every wound adds a new instrument to the orchestra.
skill.bestialis.terminal_frenzy.name: Symphony of Carnage
skill.bestialis.vampire_fangs.desc: Increases all damage dealt by 10% per level.
skill.bestialis.vampire_fangs.flavor: The night asks no permission to drink.
skill.bestialis.vampire_fangs.name: Fangs That Drink the Blood
skill.humanitas.collector_eye.desc: Reduces artifact prices in the Hemomancy Chamber shop by 5% per level (up to 15% at level 3).
skill.humanitas.collector_eye.flavor: In the castle's deck, Virgil always keeps an ace up his sleeve.
skill.humanitas.collector_eye.name: Ace of Relics
skill.humanitas.iron_will.desc: Below 30% health, take 10% less damage per level.
skill.humanitas.iron_will.flavor: The maiden may be made of iron; the will must be harder still.
skill.humanitas.iron_will.name: Iron Will
skill.humanitas.last_stand.desc: Once per run, revive upon taking fatal damage and restore 50% of max health, continuing the same run.
skill.humanitas.last_stand.flavor: Heaven will not take him. Hell cannot hold him.
skill.humanitas.last_stand.name: Between Heaven and Hell
skill.humanitas.methodical_recovery.desc: Clearing a room restores 3 health per level.
skill.humanitas.methodical_recovery.flav: Resting is allowed. Falling barefoot, never.
skill.humanitas.methodical_recovery.name: Die With Your Boots On
skill.humanitas.pocket_watch.desc: Temporary blessing effects and Bestial Fury last 10% longer per level.
skill.humanitas.pocket_watch.flavor: Seven keys guard time; an eighth opens the escape.
skill.humanitas.pocket_watch.name: Keeper of the Hours
skill.humanitas.rewritten_fate.desc: Lets you reroll a blessing offer once per map.
skill.humanitas.rewritten_fate.flavor: The mirror lies. Virgil learned to lie back.
skill.humanitas.rewritten_fate.name: Mirror of Fate
skill.humanitas.survival_instinct.flavor: When everyone else retreats, Virgil digs in his heels.
skill.humanitas.survival_instinct.name: The Final Stand
skill.humanitas.thick_skin.desc: Reduces all damage taken by 4% per level.
skill.humanitas.thick_skin.flavor: Flesh fails. Tempered conviction does not.
skill.humanitas.thick_skin.name: Stronger Than Steel
weapon.dual_revolvers.desc: Ranged combat, alternating shots between hands.
weapon.dual_revolvers.name: Twin Revolvers
weapon.longsword.basic_1.name: Greatsword I
weapon.longsword.basic_2.name: Greatsword II
weapon.longsword.basic_3.name: Greatsword Thrust
weapon.longsword.desc: Two sweeping cuts and a thrust; the quick attack spins in an area and the special slams the ground with great force.
weapon.longsword.name: Greatsword
weapon.longsword.quick.name: Whirling Cut
weapon.longsword.special.name: Crimson Fall
weapon.whip.name: Whip
